column4: Desktop page cut. Task 8's 1440 pass enumerated every section by name and count: heading + Skai Originals, chips Slots/Space/Gems, THREE description paragraphs, "What to expect" (4,000x / 92.10% RTP), the astronaut card art, Community wins (one live row), the More-games carousel (7 named tiles, no Cosmic tile), Bets, About + THREE assurances, Licences (18+), the FAQ (THREE-paragraph withdraw answer), the TWO-row footer. Counts are the measured numbers this verdict stands on, not a citation of code existing.

Tablet 768 page cut, independently reviewed by this task (not just Task 8's prose): the description paragraph reads, verbatim, "Blast off into the universe with Cosmic Slots! This thrilling 6x5 slot adventure takes you on a journey through the stars..." - an exact word-for-word match to the game-description copy FRAME_FACTS.md quotes off node 10406-11916. Chips read Slots / Space / Gems, heading reads "Cosmic slots  Skai Originals", the fairness strip shows a Skai wordmark and "Provably fair", tabs read Game details / My stats / Live chat with a Filter: All time control. Full section list below the fold (wins/carousel/bets/about/FAQ/licences/footer) not re-screenshotted at this width - see 10359-13505 for those, confirmed only at 1440.

Mobile 375 page cut. The screenshot shows only the game canvas (grid, bar, "Back / COSMIC SLOTS" breadcrumb) and the bottom app nav - it does not scroll to the sections below the game, so the hero/strip/tabs/info/wins/carousel/bets/about/FAQ/licences/footer list is unconfirmed at this specific width. Not a citation of code existing: the frame genuinely was not scrolled past in either Task 8's pass or this review.

Mobile marketing-page frame (1VH), READ FULLY in Task 4. Its own node data gives the embedded game canvas as 347px wide inside the 375-wide viewport; this task's own review of cosmic-375.png shows the game canvas occupying the width the frame's own gutters predict, and the description copy quoted from this node in FRAME_FACTS.md is the SAME text independently confirmed verbatim on the 768 page cut (10359-13264) - two independent readings agreeing on one string.

This frame's own Start-button design is not what ships.

CANONICAL Home-desktop frame. Grid (6x5, real symbols), the violet reel-grid border, spaceship (left), astronaut (right), logo, and the full bottom bar (menu / Balance / Win / Your bet / carets / spin / autoplay) are all visually present in cosmic-1440.png, reviewed directly by this task. GENUINE GAP FOUND THIS PASS, not a citation-only partial: the Universe/Galaxy/Sun ladder plaques this frame draws at panel x=187-395 (FRAME_FACTS.md) are ABSENT from the screenshot - the spaceship's x-range (180-402) shows no plaque overlaid on it. `skin.landscape.ladder` is computed in skin.ts and ReelsScene.ts's own doc comment claims the ladder "come[s] straight off the desktop Home and Combo frames", but a grep of ReelsScene.ts finds zero code references to `.ladder` outside that one comment line. No px comparison was otherwise performed for the grid/bar/logo boxes against FRAME_FACTS' numbers (visual presence only, not geometry).
